% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpComponentViewer[tag=tp-button]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/component-viewer/component-viewer.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-component-viewer");
element1.setAttribute("tag", "tp-button");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Custom content
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpComponentViewer[src=/docs/components/component-viewer/examples/button.html]{}
\end{document}
